messages.author: 243d9dde5595d8e7
messages.subject: Problems to install Nimble.
parts:
Hello,

I'm using Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, and  I've tried to install Nimble both from the website (install.packages("nimble", repos = "http://r-nimble.org") ) and from local file  by  using configure.args = "--with-eigen=/path/to/eigen" as suggested in the user manual (btw, the former method solved a problem with Eigen/Dense file  ( "Cannot find Eigen/Dense include file.") I had found when  trying to install from the webpage.

Anyway, in both cases the process (from local file and from the Nimble website) is stopped giving the following error message:

** R
** inst
** preparing package for lazy loading
Error in list2env(list(), NULL, <environment>) : 
  names(x) must be a character vector of the same length as x
Error : unable to load R code in package ‘nimble’
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘nimble’


I got sure all requirements (C++ compilers and others) are OK, and my R version is  3.0.2.

I found that somebody else had mentioned the same error when trying to install Nimble in a Mac some time ago ( https://github.com/nimble-dev/nimble/issues/99), but the solution suggested there didn't fix my problem.


As a remark, somebody else in my lab, using the same Ubuntu, got the same error message when trying to install the package.

I would really appreciate any suggestion or any hint to find out what is going wrong.

 


All the best, 



Soledad

messages.author: 2226e6c311219eb7
messages.subject: Re: Problems to install Nimble.
parts:
Hi Soledad

That's a pretty old version of R. We are at 3.2.4 now.
I would suggest updating your R installation and seeing if that
resolves the issue.
If not, please do show the entire install.packages() command you use
and all of the output that results.
This will be necessary to help figure out what went wrong.

Thanks,
Duncan

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Problems to install Nimble.
parts:
As of Nimble v0.4, we introduced an (at the time) unrealized
dependency on R >= 3.1.2 because of an issue with list2env() in R <=
3.1.1. So installation of Nimble 0.4 and 0.4-1 won't work with R 3.1.1
or older.

In our upcoming Nimble 0.5 release, the dependency on R >= 3.1.2 will
be explicit.
